messages:
alex: quick heads-up — after the terraform change that switched inference-gateway svc -> ClusterIP i'm seeing intermittent 502/healthcheck failures from the NLB in us-east.
maya: ugh, which terraform change exactly? the last PR touched aws_lb_target_group / kube_service annotations?
alex: PR #4123 — changed service.type from NodePort -> ClusterIP and updated gateway api ServiceImport. plan applied ~20m ago.
dan: if NLB target type is ip and service is ClusterIP, the AWS targets should be pod IPs via EndpointSlices (via ServiceExport/ServiceImport). Are the endpoints healthy?
alex: kubectl get endpoints svc/inference-gateway -n inference shows empty for a short window, then back. Logs show: "health check failed, protocol mismatch" from cloudwatch.
maya: can you paste service YAML + annotations? sometimes health checks use TCP vs HTTP mismatch and ALB/NLB health path / port mismatches cause 502.
alex: paste:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: inference-gateway
  namespace: inference
  annotations:
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: "nlb"
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-backend-protocol: "tcp"
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 443
      targetPort: 8080
      name: https
  selector:
    app: inference-gateway
```
maya: targetPort 8080 but nlb healthcheck probably hitting 443/TCP. If your gateway container listens on 8080 for plaintext + TLS termination at NLB level, that could be a mismatch.
priya: also check gateway API TLS mode. If Gateway is configured for TLS Passthrough and NLB is terminating TLS (or vice versa) you'll see SNI/proto mismatches. Which mode are we using?
dan: From infra: the plan set NLB passthrough for legacy apps but we intended ALB for L7. For inference-gateway we wanted TLS terminate at the Gateway (in-cluster) — that means NLB should be in TCP passthrough to pods (so target port should be 443 on pods).
alex: oh! our container expects TLS at 8080 (it unwraps). The app was built to listen TLS on 8080. If NLB is terminating TLS and forwarding plain TCP to 8080 that breaks.
maya: short-term mitigation: change service annotation to aws-load-balancer-backend-protocol: ssl or set targetPort to 443 (expose container TLS port) OR set Gateway TLS mode to Terminate and change container to serve plain HTTP on 8080. Which is less intrusive?
priya: easiest right now is to change service to include annotation `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-backend-protocol: ssl` so NLB will do TLS passthrough to backend port. But verify healthcheck config in target group — should be TCP or TLS depending.
alex: i can push a patch to terraform to set `aws_lb_target_group.health_check.protocol = "TLS"` and update k8s svc annotation for backend-protocol: ssl. PR incoming.
infra-bot: terraform plan: resources to be updated: aws_lb_target_group.inference-gw (1 change). No downtime flagged.
dan: quick check: is `targetPort: 8080` actually mapped to containerPort 8080 in Deployment? if containerPort is 443 then kubernetes will forward 443->8080? mismatch there can cause ephemeral behavior.
alex: deployment shows containerPort: 8080. so we'll change service.targetPort -> 8080 but mark backend-protocol ssl so NLB uses TCP passthrough.
maya: after you apply, watch endpoints and target group health in console `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn TG_ARN` and also `kubectl get endpoints -w svc/inference-gateway -n inference`.
priya: also add a canary iac change: toggle in terraform with a var to flip health_check.protocol for quick rollback.
alex: noted. i'll open PR with plan & screenshot of target health. pinging @maya @dan for review. will deploy during low traffic window.
maya: thx — also add a comment in PR about Gateway TLS mode to avoid future confusion :slightly_smiling_face:
dan: if this recurs we should standardize L7 vs L4 patterns in eng-platform README — i can draft a short section.
alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4187 — contains svc annotation + tg healthcheck TLS -> will apply in 15m. will report back.
infra-bot: terraform apply complete: aws_lb_target_group.inference-gw updated. timestamp 2026-03-17T15:12:34Z
alex: quick follow-up — target health stabilized after apply, endpoints stayed steady. i'll keep monitoring for 1 hour. thanks all :thumbsup:
